load_data_generator: create a data loader generator that yields batches of images from a directory with optional class conditioning and augmentation
load_single_image: load a single image file, center crop to 224x224, normalize to float32, and return as a CHW numpy array
create_imagedataset: build a PyTorch Dataset class that shards image paths across ranks and applies random crop and flip augmentation
center_crop_arr: center crop a PIL image to a target size using progressive BOX downsampling and BICUBIC upscale before cropping
random_crop_arr: randomly crop a PIL image to a target size with configurable crop fraction range and progressive downsampling
